title: Exposure (derived gross notional by key)
description: A DERIVED gross-exposure rollup. notional_usd is an exact NON-NEGATIVE decimal string - it is a gross magnitude, so two opposing positions in the same key ADD rather than cancel, which is the point of a risk view. NOTE the key naming defect this contract fixes: the Go derivation groups on InstrumentID but the derived struct's field is named `Asset` (finance/portfolio Exposure) - three names (InstrumentID / Asset / symbol) for one key. Here the key is named instrument_id, and `asset_id` exists separately for genuine asset-level rollups.

notional_usd.description: Exact NON-NEGATIVE gross magnitude - two opposing positions in one key ADD rather than cancel.
